findings.description: All five Arizona ECSE list pages (core 45, research 2, joint 25, emeritus 24, adjunct 3 = 99 cards) downloaded and parsed; no pager/next link found on any page. Names match brief.people exactly (99 of 99; no omissions, no duplicates, no extra names).
Profile pages were not downloaded; decisions rest on the five category list pages, whose title lines carry the school title. The policy's optional profile checks were not needed for any decision.
Owner determinations 2026-11-25 for other schools do not apply to this roster; none were triggered here.
